chunks: Who is more wicked than he who is reminded of his Lord's revelations yet turns away from them; We will surely requite the sinners.
ai.seo_question: Who is considered the most wicked person according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah As-Sajdah underscores the gravity of *'amal* (action) following *'ilm* (knowledge), illustrating that deliberate rejection after divine reminder constitutes a unique form of injustice (*zulm*) against the self. It serves as a profound warning that intellectual acknowledgment without spiritual acceptance leads to divine retribution, a theme frequently cited by Imams to emphasize the necessity of aligning belief with practice.
